name: quality-gates
description: Design simple, risk-based repository quality gates with affected-scope defaults and explicit full verification.

interface.shortDescription: Build lean gates that preserve critical evidence.
interface.longDescription: Audit, simplify, and implement repository quality gates. Use changed scope or explicit owners for daily work, keep full verification predictable, and retain distinct platform, safety, rollback, migration, and runtime evidence.
defaultPrompt: Simplify this repository's quality gates without weakening critical coverage.
Design affected-scope checks and a predictable release verification gate.
Find duplicate or low-value tests and reduce CI fan-out.
